doNotClosePage: Please do not close or refresh this page.
momoCancelled: You have cancelled the transaction on MoMo.
cardBlocked: Your card has been blocked. Please use another card or payment method.
invalidCardNumber: Invalid card number. Please check and try again.
cardRestricted: Your card is restricted. Please use another card.
invalidPaymentResponse: The payment gateway returned an invalid response. If you have been charged, please contact support.
orderPendingDescription: Our system is confirming your transaction. Please do not make another payment. Check your email or contact support if you have not received your tickets after a few minutes.
ticketIssuanceFailedTitle: Payment successful, but ticket issuance failed
ticketIssuanceFailedDescription: We have received your payment, but an error occurred while issuing your tickets. Please do not pay again. Contact support with your order code for assistance.
orderNotFoundDescription: The order does not exist or has expired. If you have been charged, please contact support.
amountMismatchDescription: The transaction amount does not match the order total. Please contact support for verification.
generalErrorDescription: The system encountered an error while processing your order. If you have been charged, please contact support before making another payment.
paymentFailedDescription: The transaction was cancelled or unsuccessful. You have not been charged and can try again.
